p: thy abominations: I will punish you as you have deserved for your idolatry.
watcheth for thee: He shows that the judgments of God ever watch to destroy the sinners, who notwithstanding he delays till there is no more hope of repentance.
morning is come upon thee: The beginning of his punishments is already come.
shouting upon the mountains: Which was a voice of joy and mirth.
rod hath blossomed: The scourge is ready.
pride hath budded: That is, the proud tyrant Nebuchadnezzar has gathered his force and is ready.
Violence hath risen into a rod: This cruel enemy will be a sharp scourge for their wickedness.
mourn: For he will lose nothing.
return to that which is sold: In the year of the Jubile, meaning that none would enjoy the privilege of the law, Le 25:13 for they would all be carried away captives.
vision is concerning its whole multitude: This vision signified that all would be carried away, and none would return for the Jubile.

neither shall any strengthen himself in: No man for all this endeavours himself or takes heart to repent for his evil life. Some read, for none will be strengthened in his iniquity of his life: meaning that they would gain nothing by flattering themselves in evil.
They have blown the trumpet: The Israelites made a brag, but their hearts failed them.
strangers for a prey: That is, of the Babylonians.
secret place: Which signifies the most holy place, into which none might enter but the high priest.
chain: Signifying that they would be bound and led away captives.
bloody crimes: That is, of sins that deserve death.
holy places shall be defiled: Which was the temple that was divided into three parts.
